property_summary: After a non-owner calls setApprovedLogger(address(0x123), true), the reference contract reverts the call, so the logger stays unapproved and approvedToLog(address(0x123)) returns false; the buggy contract does not revert, the logger becomes approved, and approvedToLog(address(0x123)) returns true.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier, so anyone can call setApprovedLogger.
